sources.agency: NJ Department of Community Affairs, DLGS
sources.label: PILOT Database and Viewer 2026

methodology.exempt_value: DCA assessed valuation including exempt property minus Abstract column 2 taxable land and improvements.
methodology.exempt_nonpilot_value: Derived exempt value minus DCA PILOT assessed value, floored at zero.
methodology.municipal_subsidy: DCA-published estimate in the 2026 PILOT Database; it is municipal levy impact, not total foregone conventional tax.
methodology.zero_vs_missing: Every metric carries source coverage; zero is only reported when its source municipality is present.
